content:
maya: Quick question — we have several auth entry points in our SDKs/CLI and it's causing onboarding surprises. Can we agree on a clear precedence and rotation-friendly pattern?

joel: Yup, seen this. Onboarding: users set env var, but our CLI writes a file at ~/.rw/creds and SDKs pick that up silently. That silent fallback is the culprit.

sam: Proposal: explicit precedence order and an optional CLI flag to opt-out of file-based creds. Suggested precedence: 1) explicit in-call credential param, 2) env var RW_INFER_KEY, 3) project-bound token file (~/.rw/creds for active project), 4) managed instance metadata / cloud provider.

rachel: +1 to that order. Also: env var names should be consistent across SDKs and examples. We currently have RW_INFER_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY, and RW_API — too noisy. Pick one canonical var and deprecate others with a warn window.

joel: How about RW_API_KEY as canonical? It's concise and unlikely to collide. Deprecation plan: logs warn when deprecated vars used, docs updated, + 3 releases before removal.

maya: RW_API_KEY works. For rotation: when a key is rotated by users, SDKs should not cache creds forever. Recommend SDKs re-read env vars per client instantiation and have an optional "refresh_on_unauthenticated" flag that will re-check env / file once on 401 and retry automatically.

sam: I like refresh_on_unauthenticated. Implementation notes: keep it opt-in for now, default off for strictness. Also emit a single metric 'sdk.auth.refresh_attempt' so we can surface frequent rotations causing spikes.

credbot: credbot: detected new token written to ~/.rw/creds for project "ad-server" at 17:45. :rocket:

rachel: UX edge: when both RW_API_KEY and a project-scoped token file exist, warn loudly during CLI login: "Using RW_API_KEY (env) — project token at ~/.rw/creds ignored. Use --use-project-token to override." Keep messages short.

joel: DevEx action items: 1) standardize env var to RW_API_KEY across SDKs + docs, 2) add deprecation warn for old vars, 3) implement optional refresh_on_unauthenticated in all SDKs, 4) CLI: add --use-project-token and clearer login output.

maya: Assigning: sam take SDK changes + metrics, rachel take docs + deprecation plan, joel do CLI changes. I can help with test cases for rotation.

sam: Will file a single PR in mono-repo that touches node/py/go SDKs and adds the metric. ETA EOW.

rachel: I'll draft a short changelog blurb and update quickstarts to use RW_API_KEY, include migration snippet:
```bash
# set env var (recommended)
export RW_API_KEY=sk_live_...
# OR use CLI to persist a project token
rw auth login --persist
```

maya: One more ask: add a runtime warning when SDK detects multiple credential sources saying which one is used, with a link to docs. Keep the warning rate-limited.

joel: Agree. Small follow-up: do we want to support variable scoping like RW_ORG_ID and RW_PROJECT_ID auto-detection from git remote? That could be handy but must be explicit.

sam: Auto-detect OK as heuristic for local dev, but never override explicit env or token file. Documented as helper only.

maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll open a tracking ticket and add these action items. :+1:

credbot: credbot: created ticket RW-3245 "SDK auth precedence and rotation UX" assigned to sam, rachel, joel, maya.
